snippet.title: Linkin Park
snippet.description: LP was my introduction to western music. I walked in on my cousin Furqan rapping to In The End and I was hooked. The themes of their writing have ranged from political to personal and the angst of all the inadequacies that come with these comes out in this blend of grunge, rap, and rock that I have yet to see recreated.
